title: Foreground-Aware Dataset Distillation via Dual-Path Patch Selection
abstract: arXiv:2601.02727v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a foreground-aware dataset distillation method that performs content-adaptive dual-path patch selection. With the rising computational cost of training large-scale deep models, dataset distillation has emerged as a promising approach for constructing compact synthetic datasets that retain knowledge from large original datasets. Although optimization-based methods can achieve strong performance, they often incur considerable computational and memory costs and may produce synthetic images that generalize poorly across architectures. Recent non-optimization-based methods alleviate these limitations by constructing distilled images from real-image patches. However, their inflexible patch-construction strategies may either retain redundant background content or discard important foreground structures. translated_title: 基于双路径图块选择的前景感知数据集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 随着训练大规模深度模型的计算成本不断上升，数据集蒸馏已成为一种有前景的方法，用于构建能够保留大型原始数据集知识的紧凑合成数据集。尽管基于优化的方法可以获得强大的性能，但它们通常需要相当大的计算和内存开销，并且产生的合成图像在跨架构泛化方面表现较差。近期的非优化方法通过从真实图像图块构建蒸馏图像来缓解这些限制。然而，它们僵化的图块构建策略可能会保留冗余的背景内容，或丢弃重要的前景结构。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种前景感知的数据集蒸馏框架，采用内容自适应的双路径图块选择方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种前景感知的数据集蒸馏方法，通过内容自适应的双路径图块选择策略，在保留重要前景结构的同时去除冗余背景内容，从而构建更紧凑且泛化性更好的合成数据集。
en_tdlr: A foreground-aware dataset distillation method with content-adaptive dual-path patch selection that preserves important foreground structures while removing redundant background content, enabling more compact synthetic datasets with better cross-architecture generalization.
